mehburity.speech.box.appeared: A box appeared next to you... Hit it (left click) to open it.
mehburity.speech.still_thinking: Hold on, I'm still thinking about your last question!

mehburity.ai.problem.quota: Gemini quota or rate limit reached. I'll use built-in replies for now.
mehburity.ai.problem.model_not_found: The selected Gemini model is not available. Pick another one in the settings.
mehburity.ai.problem.region: Gemini is not available in your region.
mehburity.ai.problem.network: Can't reach Gemini (no internet?). I'll use built-in replies.
mehburity.ai.problem.server: Gemini is having problems right now. I'll use built-in replies.
mehburity.ai.problem.bad_request: Gemini couldn't answer that. I'll use built-in replies.
mehburity.ai.problem.bad_response: Gemini couldn't answer that. I'll use built-in replies.
mehburity.config.title: Mehburity Settings
mehburity.config.api_key.hint: Paste your Gemini API key here
mehburity.config.no_key: No API key yet: Mehburity uses built-in replies.
mehburity.config.has_key: API key saved. Press "Test connection" to check it.
mehburity.command.no_companion: You don't have a Mehburity yet. Open your box first (/mehburity cagir).
mehburity.speech.combat.status_on: I'm protecting you. (/mehburity savas kapat to stop me)
mehburity.speech.combat.status_off: I'm not fighting right now. (/mehburity savas ac to let me protect you)
mehburity.speech.combat.server_off: Fighting is turned off on this server.
mehburity.speech.mining.start: Off I go! I'll mine the ores around here.
mehburity.speech.mining.no_block: Look at the block you want me to mine.
mehburity.speech.mining.cannot_break: I can't mine that one. (Unbreakable, or it holds items.)
mehburity.speech.mining.bag_empty: My bag is empty. Want me to go mining?
mehburity.speech.mining.none_found: I can't see any ores around here.
mehburity.speech.mining.nothing_left: No more ores around here! I mined %s blocks.
mehburity.speech.mining.bag_full: My bag is full! Say "kazdığın madenleri ver" and I'll hand everything over.
mehburity.speech.mining.trip_limit: That's %s blocks, I'm taking a break!
mehburity.speech.mining.server_off: Mining is turned off on this server.
mehburity.speech.build.server_off: Building is turned off on this server.
mehburity.speech.build.no_room: I can't build here: there is something I must not touch, or no room. Try a flatter, open spot.
mehburity.speech.build.start: Leave it to me! I'm building you a house.
mehburity.speech.build.not_building: I'm not building anything right now.
mehburity.speech.build.nothing_to_undo: I haven't built anything to take down.
mehburity.speech.build.undone: Poof! The house is gone and everything is back as it was.
mehburity.speech.build.done: Your house is ready! There's a bed, a chest and torches inside. Do you like it?
mehburity.speech.build.stopped: Okay, I stopped building. Say "evi geri al" if you want it gone.
mehburity.speech.build.held_off: Building with your own block is turned off on this server.
mehburity.speech.build.hold_block: Hold the block you want the walls made of.
mehburity.speech.build.held_unbreakable: I can't build with unbreakable blocks.
mehburity.speech.build.held_not_full: That won't make a wall. Hold a full block.
mehburity.speech.mining.busy_building: I'm building your house right now!
mehburity.speech.anger.angry: You're making me really angry... Stop it!
mehburity.speech.anger.rage: THAT'S IT! %s, I'm coming for you!
mehburity.speech.anger.rage_calmed: Fine... I calmed down. Don't do that again.
mehburity.speech.anger.rage_timeout: I'm tired of chasing. You're lucky.
mehburity.speech.anger.cake: Mmm, cake! Okay... I feel better.
mehburity.speech.anger.cake_not_angry: Thanks, but I'm not angry! Keep your cake.
mehburity.speech.anger.apology_too_soon: You just said that. Show me you mean it!
